My research runs along two tracks that keep meeting. One builds machine learning methods
for problems where the data resist standard tools — sparse labels on a blockchain graph,
free text in a permit filing, an agent population with no ground truth. The other uses
those methods, and conventional econometrics, to ask who bears risk when a market or a
policy shifts.

Working papers are listed with their current review status. Drafts are available on
request; email me and I will send the most recent version.
